en.title: Airbus sees global freighter fleet growing 46% to 3,460 jets by 2045
en.summary: Airbus' 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast projects the dedicated freighter fleet growing 46% from 2,360 aircraft in 2025 to 3,460 by 2045, requiring 2,670 new freighters, mostly to replace older models. North America and Asia-Pacific lead demand, and air cargo traffic is forecast to grow 3.2% a year over the next two decades.
body: Airbus projects the worldwide fleet of dedicated freighter aircraft to grow 46% from 2,360 in 2025 to 3,460 aircraft by 2045, according to its 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast announced at the Cargo Facts Symposium. The forecast sees a requirement for 2,670 new freighters, mainly to replace older models (1,580) and also for growth (1,090). Of the total, 1,140 will be single-aisle, 860 mid-size widebodies and 670 large widebody aircraft; some 970 will be new-build and 1,700 converted from passenger aircraft.

With long-term trade projected to expand at a 2.9% compound annual growth rate, global air cargo traffic is forecast to grow 3.2% annually over the next two decades, despite high fuel prices, geopolitical disruption and supply chain constraints. Asia-Pacific will continue to lead international air cargo traffic, with routes to North America the largest at 3.8% annual growth, followed by Europe. Regional demand for the 2,670 deliveries will be led by North America (925) and Asia-Pacific (850), together two-thirds of global demand, followed by Europe and CIS (515), Latin America (165), the Middle East (125) and Africa (90). Airbus notes air cargo carries less than 1% of global trade by weight but more than 30% by value, and that computers and high-technology goods in air cargo have doubled in value over three years to reach 15% in 2026, with e-commerce also driving demand.

facts.claim: Airbus' 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast projects the dedicated freighter fleet growing 46% from 2,360 aircraft in 2025 to 3,460 by 2045, announced at the Cargo Facts Symposium.

The forecast requires 2,670 new freighters: 1,580 for replacement and 1,090 for growth; 1,140 single-aisle, 860 mid-size widebodies and 670 large widebodies; 970 new-build and 1,700 passenger-to-freighter conversions.
Global air cargo traffic is forecast to grow 3.2% annually over two decades, with long-term trade expanding at 2.9% CAGR.

Regional demand is led by North America (925) and Asia-Pacific (850), together two-thirds of demand, followed by Europe and CIS (515), Latin America (165), the Middle East (125) and Africa (90); Asia-Pacific leads international traffic with North America routes largest at 3.8% annual growth.
Air cargo accounts for less than 1% of global trade by weight but more than 30% by value; computers and high-technology goods in air cargo doubled in value over three years to 15% in 2026.

zh.title: 空巴預測2045年全球專用貨機機隊成長46%、達3460架
zh.summary: 空巴2026年貨運市場預測指出，全球專用貨機機隊將由2025年的2360架成長46%、2045年達3460架，期間需要2670架新貨機，多數用於汰換老舊機型。北美與亞太是需求最大的兩個地區，未來20年全球空運貨量年均成長預估為3.2%。
body: 空巴在貨運事實研討會公布2026年貨運市場預測，預估全球專用貨機機隊由2025年的2360架成長46%、2045年達3460架。預測指出，期間共需要2670架貨機，其中1580架用於汰換老舊機型、1090架因應成長；以機型區分，單走道貨機1140架、中型廣體貨機860架、大型廣體貨機670架；其中970架為全新製造、1700架由客機改裝。

長期貿易年均成長預估為2.9%，全球空運貨量未來20年年均成長預估為3.2%，儘管面臨高油價、地緣政治干擾與供應鏈限制。亞太仍是國際空運貨量最大的地區，往北美航線最大、年均成長3.8%，其次為歐洲。各地區對2670架貨機的需求以北美925架、亞太850架居前，合計占全球需求三分之二，其次為歐洲與獨立國協515架、拉丁美洲165架、中東125架、非洲90架。空巴指出，空運貨量占全球貿易重量不到1%，但占貿易金額逾30%；過去3年，空運貨物中的電腦與高科技產品金額翻倍、2026年占比達15%，電子商務也是需求動能之一。
